ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Kernel Dump Using Dtrace
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious way to dump the kernel on Windows systems using dtrace.exe, which is available on Windows systems since Windows 10 19H1

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dtrace\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*lkd\\(0\\).*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*syscall\\:\\:\\:return.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*lkd\\(.*")))
